answer: Temporal Work Ledger: each identity must accumulate X hours of externally verified compute over a zephyr-like unpredictable schedule before gaining write access. Attacker cost is real parallel labor, not cash. Identities also submit quartz-timestamped checkpoints every interval; missed checkpoints decay the ledger. A glacier-slow audit randomly replays past checkpoints, and failure resets the identity to zero, so duplicated identities each pay full ongoing labor.
